title: Dynamic Stepper for guided flows
description: Data-driven Dynamic Stepper with Previous and Next buttons, controlled or uncontrolled active step, stable DOM ids for Tailwind overrides, and companion useDynamicStepper hook.

og.title: Dynamic Stepper · Zentauri UI
og.description: Navigate ordered steps with prev/next controls and optional callbacks.

twitter.title: Dynamic Stepper · Zentauri UI
twitter.description: Navigate ordered steps with prev/next controls and optional callbacks.

intro: DynamicStepper renders steps from list data with Button controls. useDynamicStepper holds the same navigation logic for fully custom layouts.
useCases: Headless step state with your own markup.
Style overrides via ids or data-slot attributes.

faqs.question: How do I target buttons or the step list with Tailwind?
faqs.answer: Each instance exposes stable id suffixes :previous, :next, and :mapper (based on React useId). data-slot attributes dynamic-stepper-previous, dynamic-stepper-next, and dynamic-stepper-mapper are also set.

faqs.question: When should I use Dynamic Stepper?
faqs.answer: Use Dynamic Stepper when a flow needs real previous and next state, callbacks, and controlled or uncontrolled active-step management.

faqs.question: Can I control the active step from the parent?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pass activeStep and onActiveStepChange for controlled mode, or defaultActiveStep for uncontrolled usage.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Steps accept optional title, description, and indicator content. Button appearance and sizes map to the shared Button component variants.
